title: Notes
adminOnly: Only the administrator archives notes and pins them to the dashboard.

confirmDelete.title: Delete the note?
confirmDelete.text: It is erased for good and cannot be recovered.

form.placeholder: E.g. The desk scanner does not read the cards.
form.privacy: Every account reads the notes: do not write pupils' personal data.
form.written: A note cannot be edited: in case of a mistake, ask the administrator to archive it and write another one.
form.pinnedHint: Shown to everyone at the top of the dashboard (and of the circulation desk) until it is unpinned or archived.

errors.empty: Write the text of the note.
errors.tooLong: The text is longer than {{max}} {{max:plural; one:character; other:characters;}}.

empty.openHint: No open notes. Notes pass problems and notices on to colleagues and the administrator.
